note: Walk-forward backtest over 365 days: each day the experts and the direction model were refit on earlier data only, then the full online system (trust weights, conformal ranges, calibration) was stepped minute by minute. The direction model's settings were picked using the days up to 2026-05-24 only; the days after it are the untouched check. Every forecast is in data/backtest/. The live record is what counts.
